identity_additions.basis: Label mapping only, no fuzzy matching and no academy/main-team conflation: Liquipedia's team page identifies 'Aurora Young Blud (formerly stylized as AuroraYoung Blood)' as Aurora Gaming's academy team, and Liquipedia's Sangal Esports page lists this exact fixture as 'Sangal vs Aurora YB' (Stake Ranked Ep. 6 Qual-Round 1, Oct 20 14:00 CEST = 12:00 UTC) — the same short label Hotspawn uses. HLTV lists the same slot as Sangal vs Aurora Young Blud (match 2399777, round of 16, Bo3, 20 Oct 12:00 UTC) and gives the team its own page (team 12366), distinct from the main Aurora roster (HLTV/VRS #6/#9). Only one team can occupy that slot. Exact opponent and UTC start are still required on every use. Plain 'Aurora' is deliberately NOT in this mapping. No official rename statement exists for the YB/Young Blud labels; the mapping is published for review.

notes: EGW header odds and EGWxxxBOT bookmaker-average sentences are aggregator displays of bookmaker odds; the underlying bookmaker is not named and no price-update timestamp is supplied. Observation time is shown on every row and the standard 8-hour evidence window applies.

Scripts/books.py re-observes accepted listing URLs on every scheduled refresh and renews the observation only when the page re-confirms the same two teams, the same UTC start and an asymmetric two-way pair; a parse miss leaves the receipt stale (a recorded finding), never a guess.

Stale search-cache snippets were found for three pages (default 1.8 odds and one 17:00 title on the Nemesis page); every accepted value in this file comes from the live re-read recorded in observed_at.
